terrain.headline: Dealer gamma is negative: research links this to larger price swings and some late-day continuation, not to a trade direction.
terrain.headline_source: Estimate assumes dealers long calls, short puts (SqueezeMetrics 2017), the convention least reliable for single stocks (Garleanu, Pedersen & Poteshman 2009). Swings: Ni, Pearson, Poteshman & White, RFS 2021; late-day continuation: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens, JFE 2021.

implied_1d_move.method: S x sigma_ATM x sqrt(1/252), one standard deviation (68.3pct); sigma = mean ATM call/put implied vol of the first expiry at least a day out

COMPOSITE.source_text: Schwab NYSE_BOOK + NASDAQ_BOOK · composite, newest quote of each exchange

detail.weights: Headline weights by price level from the touch: 0.43, 0.26, 0.16, 0.10, 0.06 (exp(-0.5·(k-1)), normalized; renormalized over the levels a thin side has). Starting weights from a vendor study (VisualHFT, touch-weighted), adjustable.
detail.zones: The headline is the book's percentage each second, as it is. BALANCED under 10%; BID or OFFER HEAVY from 10% (Bookmap's colour-switch line): direction only, not strength. A flip is a change of side, bid to offer or back.
detail.construction: Composite: every exchange's and market maker's quote from the books Schwab sends for this symbol, one per contributor by side; where a contributor quotes in both books (Nasdaq's NSDQ, for SPY and IWM), the copy with the newer quote time Schwab sent; then the shares summed at each distinct price and the best five prices per side. With one book, the composite is that book. Never the two books' level totals summed.
detail.spans: Top 5 covers different price ranges on the two venues — the percentages are over different prices, so compare directions, not magnitudes. The touch is the only like-for-like comparison across venues.
detail.books: NYSE_BOOK is each exchange's best quote grouped by price, not order depth. NASDAQ_BOOK carries Nasdaq's own quote and market makers' quotes.

liquidity.hold_note: Over the last 60 completed sessions held: a touch is a 1-minute bar reaching the level from one side, once per approach; it held when the close 15 minutes later (30 in brackets) is still on that side. Random is the same count for 100 levels a session spread over the open +- the month's largest move (Osler 2000): random levels hold about half the time, so only the difference means anything. '-' below 100 touches. A past frequency, not a forecast.

forces.method: OI side totals of the two captures, each side by the newer capture's spot; DEX = net_dex_dollars side sums on the newer capture; CHARM = dealer-signed net_charm side sums on the newer capture
